title: BPW-2026-0462
text:
[CONSENT ITEM]
BPW-2026-0462
CD ALL
BSL
CORRECTION OF RECOMMENDATION – COOPERATIVE AGREEMENT – TEMPORARY CLOSURE OF THE VINCENT THOMAS BRIDGE
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Executive Director of the Bureau of Street Lighting to negotiate and execute agreements and amendments, subject to the approval of the City Attorney as to form, which may be necessary to enter into a Cooperative Agreement with State of California, acting through its Department of Transportation (CalTrans);
AUTHORIZE funds received from CalTrans to be deposited into the SLMAF Fund (347 /50) Revenue Source 423900 or as determined by the Bureau of Street Lighting;
AUTHORIZE the Bureau of Street Lighting, Executive Director, or designee, to make any technical or accounting updates to the recommendations above to effectuate the intent of the Board of Public Works; and
AUTHORIZE the President or two members of the Board to execute the contract after approval as to form has been obtained from the City Attorney.
(REF: BPW-2026-0291)
summary: Authorize cooperative agreement with State of California regarding temporary closure of Vincent Thomas Bridge.

details.action: authorize specifications for street light replacement
